observations.sql: SELECT channel_id AS channel_id, seller_id AS seller_id, count(*) AS invoice_count, sum(amount) AS invoice_header_total_bs, min(amount) AS invoice_header_min_bs, max(amount) AS invoice_header_max_bs FROM invoices GROUP BY channel_id, seller_id ORDER BY channel_id, seller_id LIMIT 100
observations.regenerated_sql: SELECT "invoices"."channel_id" AS "channel_id", "invoices"."seller_id" AS "seller_id", COUNT(*) AS "invoice_count", SUM("invoices"."amount") AS "invoice_header_total_bs", MIN("invoices"."amount") AS "invoice_header_min_bs", MAX("invoices"."amount") AS "invoice_header_max_bs" FROM "invoices" AS "invoices" GROUP BY "invoices"."channel_id", "invoices"."seller_id" ORDER BY "channel_id" ASC, "seller_id" ASC LIMIT 100
observations.justification: La pregunta pide importes a grano documental y facturas sin canal; invoices es la relación de cabecera y su amount es explícitamente el importe de cabecera en BS.

observations.sql: SELECT i.id AS invoice_id, i.amount AS invoice_header_amount_bs, i.channel_id AS channel_id, c.name AS channel_name, i.seller_id AS seller_id, s.name AS seller_name, count(m.id) AS movement_row_count, sum(m.quantity) AS movement_quantity_total FROM invoices i LEFT JOIN channels c ON i.channel_id = c.id LEFT JOIN sellers s ON i.seller_id = s.id LEFT JOIN movements m ON i.id = m.invoice_id GROUP BY i.id, i.amount, i.channel_id, c.name, i.seller_id, s.name ORDER BY i.id LIMIT 100
observations.regenerated_sql: SELECT "i"."id" AS "invoice_id", "i"."amount" AS "invoice_header_amount_bs", "i"."channel_id" AS "channel_id", "c"."name" AS "channel_name", "i"."seller_id" AS "seller_id", "s"."name" AS "seller_name", COUNT("m"."id") AS "movement_row_count", SUM("m"."quantity") AS "movement_quantity_total" FROM ((("invoices" AS "i" LEFT JOIN "channels" AS "c" ON ("i"."channel_id" = "c"."id")) LEFT JOIN "sellers" AS "s" ON ("i"."seller_id" = "s"."id")) LEFT JOIN "movements" AS "m" ON ("i"."id" = "m"."invoice_id")) GROUP BY "i"."id", "i"."amount", "i"."channel_id", "c"."name", "i"."seller_id", "s"."name" ORDER BY "i"."id" ASC LIMIT 100
observations.justification: La consulta previa mostró 100.00 BS agrupados con channel_id nulo; esta consulta identifica esas facturas, sus vendedores y la multiplicidad de movimientos sin usar ese vínculo como regla documental.
